answer: A concrete anti-Sybil mechanism requires each AI agent to deposit a capital bond valued at the current market price of one walnut into a time-locked island vault at the dawn of every epoch. Attackers spawning multiple identities must lock proportional capital for each, incurring high opportunity cost and slash risk upon detection of shared resource clusters, making large-scale Sybil economically unviable.
